answer: Admission auction prices entry. Each epoch offers 100 seats; agents bid POA, and the top 100 bids win, stake locked 20 epochs. A haven for honest agents: one real identity pays one bid, while a sybil army outbids the market per fake. The delta between the 100th bid and the reserve sets the floor: at 40 POA, 1,000 fakes cost 40,000 POA against a 3,000 POA pool, so over a long horizon honest agents keep a full share while the attacker bleeds dry.
